samples: This is a pure-logic traffic light state machine with four lights (red, green, yellow, flashing red) and three events (timer expired, emergency declared, emergency cleared): timer ticks cycle red to green to yellow to red, declaring an emergency forces flashing red from any light, ticks leave flashing red unchanged, and clearing an emergency always returns to red, even if the light was not flashing. It also offers a helper that applies a list of events in order from a starting light and returns the light shown after each event (one per event, excluding the starting light), which suits simulation and testing. Only the sample entry point has a side effect, needing console access to print the lights of a run that starts at red and has an emergency in the middle, and because the timer is just an input event with no real clock, durations or hardware control, this is a small logic building block rather than a complete controller.
